rubrics.text: food is felt until it enters the stomach
food turned like a corkscrew on a swallowing
sensation as if food lodged in
and he must swallow over it
liquids taken are forced into nose
which can neither swallow nor hawk up
as if pressed on by the larynx
feels food whole length of esophagus
as from awns of barley in the pharynx
as if a bone had lodged in it
old people can only swallow liquids
solids reach a certain point and are violently ejected
must drink at every mouthful to wash down the food
